scope: Chunk meshing, visibility, static transforms and GL upload pacing; no gameplay or graphics-quality changes

methodology.runnerOrder: alternating legacy and optimized paths in one Android process
methodology.measures: isolated subsystem CPU time, not GPU frame time/FPS or total map loading

meshing.validation: All vertex floats (positions/normals/materials/AO) and indices identical for every sampled chunk/pass

culling.occupancy: deterministic synthetic opaque/translucent masks; unbounded frustum
culling.validation: Same opaque chunk IDs/order; JVM tests also verify both passes over 500 randomized camera/frustum scenarios

simulationSanityCheck.notes: Post-change correctness/timing check only; simulation was not changed; excludes GPU rendering

changes: One reusable padded snapshot per meshing worker, contiguous row copies, one lock/version capture for both passes
Conservative empty-pass rejection includes the neighbour halo to preserve native boundary faces
Local grid visibility broad phase with primitive reused lists and original draw order
Translation-only updates to static chunk model matrices
Soft 2 MiB/2 ms upload budget between driver calls; always allow the first mesh to avoid starvation
Skip GL texture binds when no voxel edits remain
deployment: Final app and test APK installed with adb install -r; no uninstall/data reset
